content:
elaine: hey team — hitting timeouts on long generation with python sdk. set timeout=600 but streaming fails after ~30s. using 1.2.1. logs: 'ReadTimeoutError: Stream read exceeded 30.0s' Any ideas?

sofia: hi @elaine — can you paste a minimal repro and the client init? also which env vars did you try? (created INC-1234)

support-bot: Case INC-1234 created and assigned to support-oncall.

elaine: sure, minimal:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"), timeout=600)
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-2", prompt="long story...", stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text)
```

miguel: what exactly is the exception text? full stack if possible.

elaine: stack: ReadTimeoutError: Stream read exceeded 30.0s
version: 1.2.1
env: REDWOOD_STREAM_TIMEOUT=600 (I tried), REDWOOD_TIMEOUT not set

marie: quick note — in 1.2.x we had an internal param named stream_chunk_timeout with default 30s. The env var that maps to that in 1.3+ is REDWOOD_STREAM_CHUNK_TIMEOUT. REDWOOD_STREAM_TIMEOUT won't be picked up in 1.2.1. Also the top-level timeout kw only controls request-level timeouts, not per-stream-chunk read timeouts.

elaine: oh — I set REDWOOD_STREAM_TIMEOUT (missing "CHUNK"). I'll try REDWOOD_STREAM_CHUNK_TIMEOUT now.

elaine: tried setting REDWOOD_STREAM_CHUNK_TIMEOUT=600 and restarted, still getting connection drop ~30s.

miguel: what's your http backend? requests or httpx? 1.2.1 used requests; 1.3 switched to httpx and timeout mapping changed. Also check if you're behind nginx/ingress with idle timeout ~30s.

elaine: k8s with nginx ingress. ingress.timeout is currently 30s. Other long non-stream requests succeed (they poll), but streaming always dies.

sofia: can you curl the streaming endpoint directly from inside the cluster (bypass ingress) to confirm where the cutoff is? also pls attach any proxy logs.

elaine: ran curl --no-buffer against the app from a pod; connection closed at ~31s. so looks like proxy idle timeout. I'd rather not increase ingress globally. Is there an SDK workaround for long-gen streams?

marie: for long generations we recommend either: 1) increase proxy idle timeout to > expected generation time, 2) use polling (non-stream) pattern where you submit a job and poll status, or 3) enable a server-side heartbeat/keepalive (we have an internal 'stream-heartbeat' toggle we can enable for your org) so the proxy sees activity. Short-term workaround: bump ingress for that service or use non-streaming calls. We'll file a GH issue to make stream keepalives configurable from python SDK so env var/backends are consistent across versions.

miguel: also please run with RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug and attach the SDK trace id from the failing request so we can correlate on the backend.

elaine: attaching logs to INC-1234 now (debug traces + pod logs). Thanks, we'll try ingress tweak and report back.

sofia: thanks @elaine — marking support action items: 1) eng to add SDK env-var mapping ticket (marie), 2) check server stream-heartbeat for your org (miguel), 3) follow up once ingress change tested.

marie: I'll open the GH issue and link to the ticket. For next steps: if you can share expected max gen time we can recommend exact ingress timeout config.

elaine: expected worst-case ~4-5 minutes. i'll update the ticket. thanks all :heart:
